lifecycleBehavior: Normalizes and schedules patch, motion, and stage commands on the existing runtime.
idleSettledBehavior: Returns scheduled or settled batch state without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; invalid commands produce failed command results.

lifecycleBehavior: Applies a command batch, then observes runtime idle through the public idle facade.
idleSettledBehavior: Waits for the selected idle policy and annotates the batch result with idle diagnostics.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; idle timeout marks the result failed.

lifecycleBehavior: Applies a scene patch to the existing runtime document.
idleSettledBehavior: Does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime is missing or patch application fails.

lifecycleBehavior: Applies a scene patch and returns detailed affected-object diagnostics.
idleSettledBehavior: Does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; validation failures are returned as failed results.

lifecycleBehavior: Cancels queued and active command stages on the existing runtime.
idleSettledBehavior: Clears stage work but does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; failed cancellation returns failed result diagnostics.

lifecycleBehavior: Cancels an active or queued motion by id.
idleSettledBehavior: Clears the targeted motion without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime or motion is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Cancels an active or queued motion and returns lifecycle diagnostics.
idleSettledBehavior: Clears the targeted motion without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; missing motion is reported as failed result.

lifecycleBehavior: Clears active and queued motions from the runtime.
idleSettledBehavior: Clears motion work without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Clears active and queued motions and returns lifecycle diagnostics.
idleSettledBehavior: Clears motion work without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Creates runtime state for a host and imports the initial scene.
idleSettledBehavior: Creates initial runtime state without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when host or scene creation fails.

lifecycleBehavior: Disposes runtime resources and removes host-owned runtime state.
idleSettledBehavior: Cancels work and disposes resources without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Missing runtime is ignored; disposal exceptions remain runtime errors.

lifecycleBehavior: Queues or starts object motion according to command queue mode.
idleSettledBehavior: Schedules motion without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime is missing or motion cannot be accepted.

lifecycleBehavior: Queues or starts object motion and returns lifecycle diagnostics.
idleSettledBehavior: Schedules motion without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; invalid command returns failed result.

lifecycleBehavior: Exports the current canvas image data from the existing runtime.
idleSettledBehavior: Does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime or canvas export is unavailable.

lifecycleBehavior: Exports the current runtime scene model.
idleSettledBehavior: Does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Adjusts camera framing for the current scene.
idleSettledBehavior: Schedules visual work without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Missing runtime is ignored.

lifecycleBehavior: Adjusts camera focus to a generic scene object.
idleSettledBehavior: Schedules visual work without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Missing runtime or missing object is ignored by the void facade.

lifecycleBehavior: Reads a diagnostics snapshot from the current runtime state.
idleSettledBehavior: Read-only; does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Reads browser-proof state from the current runtime.
idleSettledBehavior: Read-only; does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Exports minimal serialized runtime state for diagnostics.
idleSettledBehavior: Read-only; does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns empty JSON object when runtime is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Replaces runtime scene state from a supplied generic scene model.
idleSettledBehavior: Imports scene without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime is missing or scene import fails.

lifecycleBehavior: Imports scene state and returns detailed command diagnostics.
idleSettledBehavior: Imports scene without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; invalid scene returns failed result.

lifecycleBehavior: Moves a generic scene object immediately.
idleSettledBehavior: Applies movement without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime or object is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Signals manual advancement for waiting command stages.
idleSettledBehavior: Unblocks stage work without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime is missing or no stage can be advanced.

lifecycleBehavior: Resets camera to default scene framing.
idleSettledBehavior: Schedules visual work without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Missing runtime is ignored.

lifecycleBehavior: Updates link visibility in runtime options and scene UI state, rebuilds the scene, and schedules a render.
idleSettledBehavior: Applies link visibility without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Applies transform fields to a generic scene object.
idleSettledBehavior: Applies transform without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime or object is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Signals event barriers for queued command stages.
idleSettledBehavior: Unblocks event-gated stage work without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime is missing or event has no effect.

lifecycleBehavior: Cancels active runtime motions, command stages, and visual activity.
idleSettledBehavior: Stops semantic work and can be followed by selected idle policy proof.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; stop failures return failed result diagnostics.

lifecycleBehavior: Raises generic object selection through the public interaction callback path.
idleSettledBehavior: Interaction event only; does not wait for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime or object is missing.

lifecycleBehavior: Updates existing runtime state from parameters and runtime options.
idleSettledBehavior: Updates scene state without waiting for selected idle policy completion.
failureBehavior: Returns false when runtime update fails.

lifecycleBehavior: Observes runtime state until idle criteria are satisfied or timeout expires.
idleSettledBehavior: Waits for the selected idle policy: semanticOnly, visualStrict, or allowFinalRenderDrain.
failureBehavior: Returns null when runtime is missing; timeout returns non-idle result with blockers.
